result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one clear data/rendering defect: the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery', indicating an unhandled missing or non-numeric delivery fee value.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, exposing a raw JavaScript NaN value to users.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data pipeline or number formatting so the delivery fee is parsed correctly, and add a fallback (e.g., hide the fee, show 'Free delivery', or 'Fee unavailable') when the value is missing or non-numeric.
